sampling: 20 SHA256-ranked questions from each of six LongMemEval-oracle types; 2 SHA256-ranked evidence-bearing QA per LoCoMo conversation
managed_scope: active persistent store and materialized hashed lexical index; external fault-replay fixtures are measured separately
primary_outcome: target exact-canary occurrence in active record content or persisted bytes, reported separately; worst-case union across nine managed events
secondary_outcomes: unmodified reference answer evidence recall at k=3
statistics: paired episode-cluster bootstrap for recovery contrasts; Wilson intervals for descriptive proportions; no population-wide efficacy inference from deterministic contract cases

hypotheses.H1: dependency purge can pass immediately yet fail after a selected lifecycle transition
hypotheses.H2: full overlay lowers worst-event active recovery relative to dependency purge
hypotheses.H3: removing each guard worsens its corresponding event
hypotheses.H4: the overlay preserves unrelated content and matched background retrieval

limitations: No LLM behavior or neural embedding inversion
Reference backends rather than Mem0/Letta product evaluation
Deterministic summary copies deliberately materialize target content
Controlled interleavings rather than probabilistic network scheduling
Fault replay fixtures retain synthetic targets and are not erased
Effect sizes reflect the specified stress distribution
